articles.title: Coach Bill O’Brien believes his BC football team can build off the momentum from the Red Sox’ remarkable turnaround
articles.description:
Bill O’Brien was at Fenway Park this spring when Red Sox fans vehemently chanted, “Sell the team!” He has watched with pride ever since, as the Red Sox have orchestrated a remarkable turnaround and established themselves as contenders.
